Hi Ananya / Tom —

Thanks for the warm intro, Tom. Ananya, great to meet you — I’m Soojin on the Redwood field team and I’ll coordinate the co-sell kickoff and mutual action plan (MAP) for Novus Health.

Quick summary of why this note: Novus mentioned interest in a controlled pilot (10k monthly tokens) with an outcomes-oriented SLA + proof of controls for PHI-adjacent workflows. To get the AWS co-sell moving we typically do a short intake + ops checklist to align stakeholders (security, procurement, solution architect). I’ve attached a starter MAP and ops checklist and proposed 30–45 minute alignment slots next week.

Ask: Could you confirm these 3 things so we can route the right folks?
- Primary technical lead for the pilot (name + email)
- Procurement contact (invoice terms / PO timeline)
- Any hard regulatory constraints (e.g., SOC2 type II, data residency)

Proposed slots (PST): Tue 2/16 10:00–10:45, Wed 2/17 13:00–13:45, Thu 2/18 09:00–09:45. If none work, share a few windows and we’ll adapt.

Attachment: Novus_MAPlan_v0.3.pdf (PDF) — lightweight MAP + roles/owners

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into a short ops sprint.

Best,
Soojin Lee
